bibdata.title: Guidance on text alternatives for images
Guidance on text alternatives for images
bibdata.abstract: Recommendation ITU-T T.701.11 gives guidance on how to create text alternatives (also known as "alt-text") and what information to put in text alternatives. This Recommendation applies to all still images that are used in any type of electronic document. It also applies to individual images within a slide show. The alternative text guidance provided in this Recommendation is not applicable to moving images (e.g., movies).This Recommendation is a twin text with ISO/IEC 20071-11:2019 "Information technology User interface component accessibility Part11: Guidance on text alternatives for images", prepared by ISO/IEC JTC1 SC35 "User interfaces".
